comments: Input facts: ego is the car initiator and agent1 the pedestrian responder; the pedestrian crosses the trafficway without following another trafficway. Chosen assumptions: a straight, undivided, two-way road; pedestrian starts from the opposite sidewalk 28–30 m ahead, crossing toward the near sidewalk. Ego accelerates after 1 s from 2.5–3 m/s, closing a previously larger gap; pedestrian responds within 21–22 m by increasing walking speed from 1.2–1.4 to 2.8–3.2 m/s and clearing the ego lane. The initiating event is car acceleration, not pedestrian entry. Parameters and the 16 s horizon are assumptions; collision is not required.
